metadata.title: Singapore Spatio-Temporal Haze Sanctuary Atlas (1997-2026+)
metadata.methodology: Anisotropic Universal Kriging + MSS Wind Regimes + Sea-Breeze Flushing + Urban SVF Penalties

properties.refuge_spot: Pulau Ubin Chek Jawa Boardwalk & Ubin Jetty Point (Postal Code 508329)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Surrounded by Johor Strait channel; 85% primary mangrove forest canopy; 42 km downwind from Sumatra SW plumes.

properties.refuge_spot: Changi Point Ferry Terminal, Coastal Boardwalk & Changi Beach Park (Postal Code 498991 / 499611)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Northeastern mainland promontory; immediate South China Sea breeze ventilation; sheltered from Sumatra SW plumes.

properties.refuge_spot: Pasir Ris Park Carpark C, Mangrove Forest Walk & Coastal Boardwalk (Postal Code 519914)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Direct coastal frontage onto Johor Strait; mature mangrove vegetative filter; afternoon sea-breeze flushing.

properties.refuge_spot: Loyang Way Industrial Buffer & Jalan Loyang Besar Green Corridor (Postal Code 508783)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Johor Strait proximity provides strong maritime boundary dilution; downwind of Central water catchment.

properties.refuge_spot: Elias Mall, Pasir Ris Green Strip & Riverina Enclave (Postal Code 510625)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Residential sanctuary core; fast sea-breeze penetration along Sungei Api Api river basin.

properties.refuge_spot: Tampines Eco Green Park & Tampines East CC (Postal Code 529605)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Eastern suburban basin; moderate residential density; benefits from eastern maritime dilution.

properties.refuge_spot: Sembawang Park Coastal Pavilion, Kampong Wak Hassan & Beaulieu House (Postal Code 759819)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Northern shoreline on Johor Strait; low building density; consistent sea-breeze reversal from Northeast.

properties.refuge_spot: Bedok Reservoir Park & Heartbeat@Bedok (Postal Code 460218)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Inland East node; intermediate shelter from Sumatra SW; vulnerable to southern Kalimantan plumes.

properties.refuge_spot: Coney Island West Entrance Nature Park & Punggol Promenade (Postal Code 829325)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Full Johor Strait marine flushing; uninhabited coastal Casuarina woodland; low thermal mass.

properties.refuge_spot: Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve Visitor Centre & Coastal Trail (Postal Code 718925)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Northwest coastal wetland; extensive mangrove canopy; sheltered during southern Kalimantan plumes.

properties.refuge_spot: Punggol Point Jetty, Punggol Settlement & Coastal Promenade (Postal Code 828694)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Northern coastal exposure; rapid nocturnal clearance of trapped boundary layers via Johor Strait outflow.

properties.refuge_spot: Parkway Parade Commercial Tower & Marine Parade CC (Postal Code 449269)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Direct southern coastal exposure; first landfall for Kalimantan & South Sumatra plumes; avoid outdoor coast during SE winds.

properties.refuge_spot: Springleaf Nature Park & Upper Thomson / Seletar Reservoir Green Buffer (Postal Code 787130)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Adjacent to Central Catchment forest reserve; high evapotranspiration; natural vegetative dry deposition.

properties.refuge_spot: MacRitchie Reservoir Treetop Walk & Upper Peirce Reservoir (Postal Code 779914)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Largest contiguous rainforest in Singapore; maximum vegetative PM2.5 scavenging; zero vehicular heat island.

properties.refuge_spot: NEX District-Cooled Civic Complex (Postal Code 556083)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Inland North-East valley; moderate nocturnal thermal trapping; good HEPA indoor sanctuaries.

properties.refuge_spot: ION Orchard / Ngee Ann City Underpass HEPA Network (Postal Code 238801)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Valley topography flanked by Mount Sophia and Fort Canning; suppresses vertical boundary layer mixing.

properties.refuge_spot: Marina Bay Sands / Marina Bay Financial Centre MERV-14 Enclosed Sanctuaries (Postal Code 018956)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: High-density urban canyon; nocturnal thermal inversion traps particulates below 120m; direct hit from SE plumes.

properties.refuge_spot: Guoco Tower District-Cooled Concourse (Postal Code 079903)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Deep urban canyon; heavy heat retention; high particulate concentration 02:00-08:00 SGT.

properties.refuge_spot: VivoCity Enclosed Retail Concourse (Postal Code 098585)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Immediate southern coastline overlooking Keppel Harbour; highly vulnerable to SE/S Kalimantan plumes.

properties.refuge_spot: Westgate & JEM Linked Enclosed District Centers (Postal Code 608532)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: West-central transportation hub; exposed to Sumatra SW advection corridor; seek indoor HEPA air.

properties.refuge_spot: Jurong Point Air-Conditioned Shopping Complex (Postal Code 648310)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Direct path of Sumatra SW smoke plume; elevated 1-hr PM2.5 within 2 hours of Malacca Strait crossing.

properties.refuge_spot: Jurong Island Checkpoint Administration Building (Postal Code 627885)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Southern offshore industrial complex; hits peak PSI first during SW plumes; zero maritime vegetative buffer.

properties.refuge_spot: Pioneer Sector Indoor Commercial Complexes (Postal Code 628439)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Heavy industrial corridor; combined transboundary SW smoke and local industrial background.

properties.refuge_spot: Tuas South Recreation Centre Enclosed Facility (Postal Code 637607)
properties.meteorological_mechanism: Ground Zero for Sumatra SW plumes (200°-250°); acute initial landfall; highest peak PM2.5 in June 2013.
